newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish stocks vulnerable to profit-taking - Nomura.
newsitem.headline: Polish stocks vulnerable to profit-taking - Nomura.

text.p: Nomura Equity Research believes the Warsaw bourse, which fell 14.7 percent in October, could still fall on profit-taking before the end of the year, Nomura said in its November report.
"In the short term, selective stocks could continue to rebound, but we believe that the market remains vulnerable to further profit taking before the end of the year," it said.
Nomura said the sell-off was mainly caused by profit-taking, following about 100-percent gains since the beginning of the year.
Nomura said its top picks were WBK and Kety.
